spans.s: प्रति—तद्-विद् f. recognition of the contrary, KauṣUp.
प्रति—तन्त्रम् ind. according to each Tantra or opinion, W.
प्रति—तन्˚त्र—दर्पण m. N. of wk.
प्रति—तन्˚त्र—सिद्धान्त m. a doctrine adopted in various systems (but not in all), Nyāyas.; Car.
प्रति—तरा॑म् ind. (with √ भू) to retire or shrink more and more, ŚBr.
प्रति—तरु ind. at each tree, Gīt.
प्रति—ताल m. (in music) a kind of measure
प्रति—ताली f. the key of a door, L.
प्रति—तालक m. = prec. m. and f., L.
प्रति—तूणी f. a modification of the nervous disease called Tūṇī, Suśr. (cf. प्र-तूणी).
प्रति—त्र्यहम् ind. for three days at a time, Gaut.
प्रति-√ तड् P. -ताडयति, to strike in return, MBh.
प्रति-˚ताडितव्य n. (impers.) a blow must be returned, L.

प्रति-√ तप् P. -तपति, to throw out or emit heat towards or against (acc.), AV.; TāṇḍBr.;
to heat, warm, foment, GṛŚrS.
a sailor, oarsman, ferryman, Suśr.
expected, comprehensible (अ-प्र्˚), R. (B.)
प्रति-√ तर्ज् (only ind.p. -तर्ज्य), to menace, threaten, terrify, Kir. xiv, 26.
प्रति-√ तिज् to emit heat or fire against or towards, MaitrS. (only Impv. प्र॑ति-तिग्धि and -तितिग्धि, for which Kāṭh. प्रति-तित्यग्धि [!], and ĀpŚr. प्रति-तिङ्ढि [!]).
See अ॑-प्र्˚.
See अ॑-प्रतीत्त.
acknowledged, recognized, known (श्यामैति, ‘by the name of Ś˚’), Nir.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
convinced of anything, trusting in, firmly resolved upon (comp.), KaṭhUp.; MBh.; Hit.
satisfied, cheerful, glad, pleased, AitBr.; MBh. &c.
respectful, L.
past, gone, L.
clever, wise, L.
N. of a divinity enumerated among the Viśve Devās, MBh.
&c. See under 2. प्रती.
प्रती—तोद m. N. of partic. initial forms of Padas in hymns, Nid.
प्रतीत—सेन m. N. of a prince, Buddh.
प्रती˚ताक्षरा f. N. of a Comm. on the Mitākṣarā
प्रती˚तात्मन् mfn. confident, resolute, MBh.
प्रती˚तार्थ mfn. having a recognized or acknowledged meaning, Nir.
प्रती˚ताश्व m. N. of a prince, VP.
going towards, approaching, RV.
the following from anything (as a necessary result), being clear or intelligible by itself, Vedāntas.
clear apprehension or insight into anything, complete understanding or ascertainment, conviction, Śak.; Śaṃk.; Kathās. &c.
confidence, faith, belief, Daś.
trust, credit, Inscr.
fame, notoriety, W.
respect, ib.
delight, ib.
प्रतीति—मत् mfn. known, understood, Harav.
confirmation, experiment, RV. vii, 68, 6
comfort, consolation, ib. iv, 5, 14 (others mfn. to be acknowledged or recognized)
प्रतीत्य—समुत्पाद m. (Buddh.) the chain of causation, Lalit. (twelvefold; cf.
Dharmas. 42
mf(ई)n. (fr. प्रतीति) existing only in the mind, mental, subjective, Sarvad.
